title: Growth Product Manager roadmap
summary: A focused plan to solidify core growth fundamentals, develop data-driven experimentation skills, build A showcase portfolio, and prepare for hiring. Each phase balances learning, hands-on practice, and reflection.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish the core concepts of funnels, metrics, and prioritisation.

milestones.title: Understand growth funnels
milestones.outcome: Can map end-to-end user journeys and identify key conversion points.

tasks.title: Read growth funnel guide on Reforge
tasks.description: Study the funnel framework and typical KPI definitions.

tasks.title: Sketch a funnel for a favorite app
tasks.description: Create a visual funnel diagram on paper or a whiteboard, labeling each stage and metric.

tasks.title: Calculate conversion rates with sample data
tasks.description: Use a CSV of mock user events to compute stage-by-stage conversion percentages.

tasks.title: Reflect on bottlenecks you observed
tasks.description: Write a short note on which stage shows the biggest drop and why.

milestones.title: Prioritisation frameworks
milestones.outcome: Can rank growth ideas using a structured model.

tasks.title: Watch prioritisation video on Coursera
tasks.description: Focus on RICE and ICE frameworks and their calculations.

tasks.title: Score five hypothetical experiments
tasks.description: Apply RICE to five ideas, documenting each score in a spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Create a prioritisation board in Trello
tasks.description: Set up columns for backlog, high-priority, and low-priority items.

tasks.title: Discuss scores with a peer
tasks.description: Explain your reasoning to a colleague or online community for feedback.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Gain hands-on ability with data, experimentation, and copy.

milestones.title: SQL for growth analysis
milestones.outcome: Can write queries to extract funnel and cohort metrics from a relational DB.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics on Mode Analytics
tasks.description: Finish the interactive lessons covering SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and window functions.

tasks.title: Query a public dataset on Kaggle
tasks.description: Use the “Spotify Tracks” dataset to calculate daily active users and retention cohorts.

tasks.title: Build a reusable funnel query template
tasks.description: Create a parameterised SQL script that returns conversion rates for any funnel you define.

tasks.title: Share query on Stack Overflow
tasks.description: Post a concise question about a window-function challenge you faced and note the answer you received.

milestones.title: Experiment design
milestones.outcome: Can design, launch, and evaluate A/B tests with statistical rigor.

tasks.title: Read experiment design chapter on Optimizely blog
tasks.description: Focus on hypothesis formulation, sample size, and significance testing.

tasks.title: Draft hypotheses for three product tweaks
tasks.description: Write clear, measurable statements linking a change to a KPI.

tasks.title: Set up a mock A/B test in Google optimize
tasks.description: Create two variants, define the goal metric, and configure traffic split using dummy URLs.

tasks.title: Calculate required sample size
tasks.description: Use an online calculator to determine users needed for 95% confidence and 5% lift.

milestones.title: Copy & onboarding tactics
milestones.outcome: Can craft persuasive copy and design onboarding flows that improve activation.

tasks.title: Study onboarding case studies on Appcues
tasks.description: Identify common patterns that boost first-day activation.

tasks.title: Write headline variants for a signup page
tasks.description: Create three distinct headlines and subcopy aimed at the target persona.

tasks.title: Prototype an onboarding flow in Figma
tasks.description: Design a 3-step onboarding sequence with copy, illustrations, and CTA placements.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a growth forum
tasks.description: Post your copy and flow in the GrowthHackers community and note constructive critiques.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that demonstrate real-world growth impact.

milestones.title: Funnel analysis project
milestones.outcome: Can present a data-driven funnel audit with actionable insights.

tasks.title: Select a public SaaS product
tasks.description: Choose a well-known service (e.g., Dropbox) and define its user funnel stages.

tasks.title: Gather public usage data
tasks.description: Extract traffic estimates from SimilarWeb and combine with any available API data.

tasks.title: Build a funnel dashboard in Google data Studio
tasks.description: Visualise each stage’s volume and conversion rate with charts.

tasks.title: Write a 2-page analysis report
tasks.description: Summarise findings, highlight biggest drop-off, and suggest three experiments.

tasks.title: Publish the report on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Share the analysis as a carousel post and invite comments.

milestones.title: Experiment backlog & sizing
milestones.outcome: Can maintain a prioritized backlog with effort estimates and expected impact.

tasks.title: Create a backlog spreadsheet
tasks.description: List 15 growth ideas, each with RICE score, hypothesis, and metric.

tasks.title: Estimate implementation effort
tasks.description: Assign story points based on design, engineering, and QA workload.

tasks.title: Write a sizing rationale document
tasks.description: Explain why each idea received its effort estimate and projected lift.

tasks.title: Share backlog with a mentor
tasks.description: Request feedback on feasibility and prioritisation logic via email or Slack.

milestones.title: Onboarding teardown
milestones.outcome: Can critique an existing onboarding flow and propose data-backed improvements.

tasks.title: Choose an app with free signup
tasks.description: Sign up for a popular productivity tool and record the onboarding steps.

tasks.title: Map the onboarding funnel
tasks.description: Document each screen, user action, and time spent using a simple table.

tasks.title: Identify friction points
tasks.description: Highlight steps with unclear copy or excessive fields and note drop-off hypotheses.

tasks.title: Design revised screens in Figma
tasks.description: Create mockups that simplify the flow and improve copy clarity.

tasks.title: Present redesign to a peer group
tasks.description: Walk through the before-after comparison and gather critique.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance your toolkit and prepare for interviews or client pitches.

milestones.title: Advanced analytics tools
milestones.outcome: Can navigate Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Looker to surface growth insights.

tasks.title: Complete Mixpanel fundamentals on Mixpanel Academy
tasks.description: Finish the free module covering event tracking and funnel reports.

tasks.title: Build a cohort analysis in Amplitude
tasks.description: Create a cohort of users who completed onboarding and track 30-day retention.

tasks.title: Set up a Looker dashboard template
tasks.description: Use Looker’s public demo to replicate a growth KPI dashboard.

tasks.title: Write a one-page insights summary
tasks.description: Summarise key takeaways from each tool and how they differ.

tasks.title: Discuss tool choices with a senior PM
tasks.description: Ask about trade-offs and preferred workflows in a short call or chat.

milestones.title: Interview & pitch prep
milestones.outcome: Can confidently discuss metrics, experiments, and portfolio work in interviews or client meetings.

tasks.title: Draft STAR stories for three growth wins
tasks.description: Structure each story with Situation, Task, Action, Result, focusing on metrics.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Run a 30-minute role-play covering hypothesis generation and data interpretation.

tasks.title: Create a one-page portfolio deck
tasks.description: Combine the three portfolio projects into a concise PDF with screenshots and outcomes.

tasks.title: Record a 2-minute pitch video
tasks.description: Present your portfolio to a camera, then review for clarity and pacing.

milestones.title: Continuous growth learning
milestones.outcome: Has a personal development loop for staying current on growth trends.

tasks.title: Subscribe to growth newsletters (e.g., GrowthHackers, Lattice)
tasks.description: Add them to your email and set a weekly reading slot.

tasks.title: Join a monthly growth meetup
tasks.description: Attend a virtual or local event and share a recent experiment outcome.

tasks.title: Write a monthly experiment retrospective blog
tasks.description: Document what worked, what didn’t, and next steps in a public post.

tasks.title: Update portfolio with new results
tasks.description: Add any new experiment data or insights to keep the showcase fresh.
